title: Mobility Carsharing
description: Swiss carsharing for the Teneo voice demo: voice authentication (name, driving licence, one-time code), extending a booking (with a conflict and an EV charge check, or simple), reporting damage before a trip, booking a van, and disputing a cleaning fee. Swiss customers, prices in CHF.
notes:
Brand-neutral data, fictional phone numbers (+41 79 555 ...) and example.com emails. Booking times are local Zurich times (HH:mm) on the day in 'date'; dates are relative to the day the config is loaded, so reset it before a demo. The Teneo solution uses a demo clock (global demoClock, default 16:40) so the times in the script always fit.

Test customers:
- Anna Meyer (C001, licence CH-ZH-8847261, mobile ending 89, one-time code 482913): the demo script. Active booking BK-118001 on the VW ID.3 (V101) until 18:00 at 38% charge; Thomas Keller has the same car from 19:30, so the latest return is 19:15. Flex plan, about 10 hours a month in comfort EVs, so Flex Plus would save about CHF 15 a month. Card on file: Visa ending 1234.

- Thomas Keller (C004, licence CH-ZH-6120448, code 204877): owns the conflicting booking BK-118002 and tomorrow's ID.4 booking.

The Corolla already has a known dent (DMG-2201); she reports a new cracked mirror, so she is moved to the ID.4 (also with child seat).
- Jonas Weber (C006, licence CH-ZH-2258316, mobile ending 73, code 640218): lives at Limmatstrasse 150 and books a van for tomorrow 9-13: Ford Transit at Hardbruecke (about 10 minutes on foot) or Renault Trafic at Altstetten.
- Sofia Brunner (C007, licence CH-ZH-7730564, mobile ending 18, code 829140): customer since 2020, open cleaning fee FEE-3101 (CHF 80, pet hair) on invoice INV-7001 for the VW Polo two weeks ago.

Catalogue: plans (OCCASIONAL, FLEX, FLEX_PLUS with hourly rates per vehicle class), stations with coordinates, destinations with distances from Zurich and the fast charger there, rules R-EV (minimum return charge), R-BOOKING (turnaround, walking speed) and R-DISCOUNT, plus the policy rules R-LATE, R-ABROAD, R-DAMAGE, R-CLEAN, R-DRIVERS, R-PETS and R-EXTRAS (their description is the text the assistant may answer from). Also damages, fees and invoices. The flows write otp_codes, messages, new bookings, damages and cases.
